# Hair Techniques Salon & Spa

> Hair salon & spa based in Bloomington, Indiana. A full-service salon and spa on South Liberty Drive for more than 24 years. Cuts, color, balayage and color correction from stylists who listen, fix what went wrong, and show you how to style it at home.

- Phone: (812) 335-0690
- Based in: Bloomington, IN
- Nearby areas: Bloomington, Ellettsville, Bedford, Spencer, Martinsville, Nashville
- Google rating: 4.7 from 71 reviews

## Services
- Cuts & styling: Precision cuts for women, men and kids, including thick, coarse and wavy hair, plus the know-how to style it yourself.
- Color & color correction: All-over color, grey coverage, highlights, balayage and color correction, from stylists clients call color artists.
- Spa services: Want pampering? Spa services under the same roof as your stylist, so you can make an afternoon of it.

## About
Hair Techniques Salon & Spa has been a full-service salon and spa at 1903 S Liberty Dr, on the south side of Bloomington, for more than 24 years. Students, IU faculty, medical professionals, families and even truckers passing through all sit in the same chairs, and some clients drive an hour to get here. People come back for the stylists. Reviews name Ashley, a color artist who handles everything from a simple color to a full color correction, and Brandi Ward, whose precise cuts and bold color fill the gallery. In 2026 Shawna came back to the salon after years away, bringing fresh looks, color, dimensional blonding and precision cuts. Customer service is the #1 priority here: they take the time to get it right, explain how to style it at home, and make room on short notice when they can. The salon was recognized in the Herald-Times 2022 Best of B-Town Community Choice Awards, and as they tell their regulars: without you, this wouldn't be possible.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Can you fix a color that went wrong?
  A: Yes. Color correction is a specialty. Clients have come in to undo box dye and bright reds and get back close to their natural shade. Call (812) 335-0690 to book a consultation.
- Q: Can you cut thick, coarse or curly hair?
  A: Yes. Reviewers with thick, coarse and wavy hair say they got their best cut in years here. Tell your stylist how you wear it day to day, straight or curly, before the cut.
- Q: Do you take short-notice appointments?
  A: Often, yes. Regulars say we make room on short notice. Call (812) 335-0690 to see who's free.
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Tuesday and Thursday 10 to 5, Wednesday and Friday 10 to 8, Saturday 10 to 4. Closed Sunday and Monday.
- Q: Where are you, and is there parking?
  A: 1903 S Liberty Dr, Bloomington, IN 47403, on the south side of town, an easy drive from the IU campus. Reviewers mention lots of convenient parking.
- Q: Do you offer spa services?
  A: Yes, spa services alongside the salon. Call (812) 335-0690 to ask what's available and book.
